references.rationaleIt: Arrivo dei due amici, proposta della passeggiata e ritorno finale nella hall.
references.quote: Instead of receiving any such letter of excuse from his friend, as Elizabeth half expected Mr. Bingley to do, he was able to bring Darcy with him to Longbourn before many days had passed after Lady Catherine's visit. The gentlemen arrived early; and, before Mrs. Bennet had time to tell him of their having seen his aunt, of which her daughter sat in momentary dread, Bingley, who wanted to be alone with Jane, proposed their all walking out. It was agreed to. Mrs. Bennet was not in the habit of walking, Mary could never spare time, but the remaining five set off together. Bingley and Jane, however, soon allowed the others to outstrip them. They lagged behind, while Elizabeth, Kitty, and Darcy, were to entertain each other. Very little was said by either; Kitty was too much afraid of him to talk; Elizabeth was secretly forming a desperate resolution; and perhaps he might be doing the same.

references.rationaleIt: Dopo il passaggio presso i Lucas, la conversazione e l’accettazione proseguono per diverse miglia senza direzione osservata; scena nel territorio del vicinato, senza tracciato ricostruibile.
references.quote: They walked on, without knowing in what direction. There was too much to be thought; and felt, and said, for attention to any other objects. references.quote: In the evening, soon after Mr. Bennet withdrew to the library, she saw Mr. Darcy rise also and follow him, and her agitation on seeing it was extreme. She did not fear her father's opposition, but he was going to be made unhappy, and that it should be through her means, that she, his favourite child, should be distressing him by her choice, should be filling him with fears and regrets in disposing of her, was a wretched reflection, and she sat in misery till Mr. Darcy appeared again, when, looking at him, she was a little relieved by his smile. In a few minutes he approached the table where she was sitting with Kitty; and, while pretending to admire her work, said in a whisper, "Go to your father, he wants you in the library." She was gone directly.

references.rationaleIt: La passeggiata proposta verso Oakham Mount è effettivamente compiuta e contiene il colloquio sull’assenso dei genitori. Non si afferma che la conversazione avvenga già sulla cima.
references.quote: During their walk, it was resolved that Mr. Bennet's consent should be asked in the course of the evening. Elizabeth reserved to herself the application for her mother's. She could not determine how her mother would take it; sometimes doubting whether all his wealth and grandeur would be enough to overcome her abhorrence of the man. But whether she were violently set against the match, or violently delighted with it, it was certain that her manner would be equally ill adapted to do credit to her sense; and she could no more bear that Mr. Darcy should hear the first raptures of her joy, than the first vehemence of her disapprobation.

references.rationaleIt: Meta e panorama proposti; non c’è una scena descritta sulla sommità.

notes.en: Visits and dances connect the Bennets, the Lucases and Netherfield; Elizabeth crosses fields and stiles to reach her ill sister.
notes.it: Visite e balli collegano i Bennet, i Lucas e Netherfield; Elizabeth attraversa campi e staccionate per raggiungere la sorella malata.
notes.fr: Visites et bals relient les Bennet, les Lucas et Netherfield ; Elizabeth traverse champs et barrières pour rejoindre sa sœur malade.
notes.es: Visitas y bailes unen a los Bennet, los Lucas y Netherfield; Elizabeth atraviesa campos y cercas para llegar hasta su hermana enferma.

notes.en: Charlotte’s parsonage stands near Lady Catherine’s imposing domain. Between the house, park and outside lane, Elizabeth’s encounters with Darcy unsettle her judgments.
notes.it: La canonica di Charlotte sorge vicino all’imponente dimora di Lady Catherine. Fra casa, parco e vialetto esterno, gli incontri con Darcy scuotono i giudizi di Elizabeth.
notes.fr: Le presbytère de Charlotte est proche de l’imposant domaine de Lady Catherine. Entre maison, parc et allée extérieure, les rencontres avec Darcy ébranlent les jugements d’Elizabeth.
notes.es: La casa parroquial de Charlotte está cerca del imponente dominio de Lady Catherine. Entre casa, parque y sendero exterior, los encuentros con Darcy sacuden los juicios de Elizabeth.

notes.en: The house, river and wooded walks reveal a different image of Darcy. Elizabeth’s visit with the Gardiners becomes an unexpected encounter with the owner.
notes.it: La dimora, il fiume e i sentieri nel bosco rivelano un’immagine diversa di Darcy. La visita di Elizabeth con i Gardiner diventa un incontro inatteso con il proprietario.
notes.fr: La demeure, la rivière et les promenades boisées révèlent une autre image de Darcy. La visite d’Elizabeth avec les Gardiner devient une rencontre inattendue avec le propriétaire.
notes.es: La casa, el río y los senderos arbolados revelan otra imagen de Darcy. La visita de Elizabeth con los Gardiner se convierte en un encuentro inesperado con el propietario.

description: Elizabeth and Darcy between country houses, muddy paths and the wooded valleys of Derbyshire.
Elizabeth e Darcy tra dimore di campagna, sentieri fangosi e valli boscose del Derbyshire.
Elizabeth et Darcy entre demeures de campagne, chemins boueux et vallées boisées du Derbyshire.
Elizabeth y Darcy entre casas de campo, senderos embarrados y valles boscosos de Derbyshire.
